bull_case: 유리한 사업·자본배분 가정이 유지되면 기준 점수보다 높은 결과가 가능하다.
bear_case: 성장·마진·자본배분이 정상화되고 핵심 불확실성이 불리하게 전개되면 기준 점수보다 낮아질 수 있다.
thesis: Berkshire's balance-sheet survival capacity is exceptional. The main risks are not solvency but opportunity cost, insurance tail losses and capital deployment at enormous scale.

evidence.claim: Insurance and Other cash/cash equivalents/T-bills were $359.2B at June 30, 2026.
Borrowings excluding BHE/BNSF were $43.3B; Berkshire does not guarantee BNSF/BHE debt.
Berkshire acquired $4.8B of treasury stock in H1 2026.
Insurance float was about $177.5B at June 30, 2026.

counterevidence: BHE/BNSF carry large debt loads at subsidiary level.
Insurance liabilities can create large but uncertain cash demands after catastrophes.
The securities portfolio creates mark-to-market volatility even when solvency remains strong.
unknowns: Maximum probable aggregate catastrophe cash outflow under clustered events.
Future BHE capital requirements and regulatory recovery timing.
falsifiers: Cash/T-bill liquidity falls below management's $30B floor.
Operating cash generation fails to cover mandatory capex and claims.
Berkshire begins repeated parent-level financing for ordinary operations.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Operating businesses and investment income generate internal funds; external capital is not structurally required for survival.
Share count is falling and H1 2026 included $4.8B repurchases.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Exceptional liquidity and diversified earning power make bankruptcy/business extinction probability very low.

subscores.rationale: Insurance/Other cash and T-bills $359.2B versus $43.3B borrowings excluding BNSF/BHE; liquidity is exceptional.
Berkshire preserves a $30B cash/T-bill floor for repurchases and has diversified internally generated earnings.
Share count is declining through repurchases; BNSF/BHE debt is structurally ring-fenced and Berkshire does not guarantee it.
